issues.on_page: Other Governmental Funds Other local receipts 462,552.95 (p4); Exhibit J receipts 424,691.77 (p13)
issues.issue: The Activity Fund share of 'Other local receipts' isn't printed anywhere. It is the remainder of the printed Other Governmental line after the Student Fee, Nutrition, Cooperative and QCPU items (the same as 424,691.77 less the 36,000 transfer less 161,677.44 dissolved-district cash). The arithmetic is right and it is marked computed and review, but it rests on the assumption that Exhibit J receipts include those two amounts.

issues.on_page: Statement of Activities: Special education Charges for Services 117,912.69; Cooperative Fund 'Received from other districts' (p17)
issues.issue: The report's own Statement of Activities counts this as charges for services (cooperative/interlocal payments from other districts). The extractor rules put interlocal-agreement revenue under charges for services/fees. Judgment call. The same applies to detail[230].
This could be other charges for services (cooperative/interlocal), matching the Statement of Activities on p2.

issues.on_page: School Nutrition Fund is reported inside Other Governmental Funds (p4, Exhibit K p14); no proprietary statement
issues.issue: School nutrition is normally business-type under the extractor rules, but this report presents it as a governmental fund with no proprietary statement. Kept governmental to tie to the printed totals. Confirm this is acceptable.
